kids: 🗺 Starlane adventures! Puzzles and missions that pop up while you play — defuse a bomb, fix the radio, meet aliens, travel back in time
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: the first six adventures — three In-Ship (The Ticking Canister, Radio Silence, The Stowaway) and three Space (The Black-Hole Time-Warp, First Contact, Planet-Killer) — mixing science and maths puzzles with flying tasks. They appear after you have some experience (after a fight, in hyperspace or on a quiet flight), never more than one every 20 minutes. Rewards include credits, a bobble-head alien and a prototype tractor beam; failing only costs something small. Completed adventures can be replayed from the new 🗺 ADVENTURE LOG in the pause menu, which also sets the puzzle level (younger, middle, older). Test mode has an ADVENTURES page.

kids: 🎨 Starlane: paint your ship — colours, stripes, a decal and your own name — and see every upgrade on the hull
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: your ship now shows what is fitted — each laser type looks different (pulse, beam, twin, military, plasma, mining drill), missiles hang under the wings, and scoops, cargo pod, ECM antenna, docking-computer dome, afterburners, tractor dish, shield emitters, energy strip, fire-control pod, repair drones and Starburst emitters all appear. New shipyard page 🎨 EXTERIOR: main, trim and stripe colours, stripes, decals, a name and number, with a turning preview; applying costs 150 Cr. Your look appears in the hangar, the outside camera and the movies.

kids: 🧪 Grown-ups: a Starlane test mode for trying out every part of the game
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: press Ctrl+Shift+G while playing and enter the parent passphrase (or Admin PIN) to open TEST MODE — a practice copy of the game. Jump straight into 22 scenarios (launch, docking approaches, the docking computer, races, battles, police, Vorn interdiction, hyperspace, black holes, flares, mining, scooping, rescues, derelicts, missiles, the jump drive, the hangar seat); add any mission or story; set credits, fuel, hull, legal status and rank; fit any equipment, laser or ship; visit any galaxy or system; and switch on cheats (invincible, infinite fuel and missiles, free shopping). EXIT TEST MODE returns you to exactly where you were; nothing is saved.

kids: 🚀 Starlane: leaving a station no longer shows the docking guide
🎓 Nova’s tour narration is no longer cut off by other voices
📡 A brand-new radar in the Modern cockpit
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: after launch, the docking corridor, “line up / match the spin” hints and spin buttons stay hidden until you are 3.5 km clear of the station or turn back to face it. During tours other game voices stay quiet, so they can no longer cut off the lesson narration. Modern radar redesigned: glowing glass with tick marks and labelled range rings, a smooth sweep, ships as arrows pointing the way they fly, pulsing rings on hostile ships, a spinning station marker, shaded planets and a glowing sun, rim pointers for things out of range, and rotating target brackets.

kids: 🧸 Starlane: make the cockpit your own — fuzzy dice, a bobble-head alien, fairy lights, a cat plush and more in the shipyard’s PERSONAL tab
🕹️ A real flight stick, deeper instrument panels and a lived-in cockpit (switch the clutter off in Display if you like it tidy)
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader (Modern cockpit): framed instrument screens with glare hoods, a proper flight stick, a cockpit floor, and lived-in clutter (mug, tablet, cables, tools, sticky notes) — Display → LIVED-IN COCKPIT turns it on or off. New PERSONAL shipyard category with ten cockpit items: fuzzy dice, bobble-head alien, pot plant, photo frame, scarf, trophy, toy rocket, cat plush, comic book and fairy lights. You can look further down to see the stick.

kids: 🎓 Starlane tours rebuilt: 17 longer lessons, Nova talks you through each step, and you can see the real keyboard and mouse being used
🛬 A proper docking lesson — approach from the side, level the slot, then let the docking computer do it
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: tours rebuilt — each step waits for Nova to finish speaking (with a timed fallback), movies stay on, Modern controls steer with the mouse pointer, and a realistic keyboard and mouse light up as they are used. New docking lesson (off-angle approach, levelling and spin-matching, then the docking computer) and five new tours: your cockpit, sitting in the station, rescues and surveys, police and the law, saving and settings. Ending a tour returns you to where you started it. Fixed: fuel scoops were missing from the Shipyard categories.

kids: 🛒 Starlane: a bigger shipyard with pages — and new gear: Starburst laser (5), fire-control computer (6), plasma cannon, twin beams, shield booster, repair drones, tractor beam and afterburner
🖥️ Movies, rear and side views now fill a widescreen too
🔢 Nova says numbers like 6.2 properly
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Shipyard categories (Essentials, Weapons, Defence, Systems) with automatic pages and a description of each item; the Market pages automatically as goods are added. New: twin beam and plasma lasers, Starburst laser charges, shield booster, fire-control computer, repair drones, tractor beam, afterburner. After being destroyed you restart at the station where you last docked. Movies, the rear/side views and the outside camera use the full widescreen; ships in movies show their full detail.
🔊 Speech: numbers with a decimal point are read as “six point two”, everywhere in the app.

kids: 💥 Starlane: you can see every hit now — shield flashes, spreading cracks and red warnings as your ship gets close to destruction
💾 Typing a save name now works properly
📋 Click a mission to read its recap
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: hits show a shield arc (blue) or hull arc (red) at the front or rear; damage builds with lost energy (cracks, smoke, sparks, flicker); staged warnings — shield low, shield down, energy low, hull critical — with Nova, alarms and an escape-capsule prompt. Save-as name is a real text box (typing P no longer pauses the game). Click a mission under “Your missions” for its recap. Supply missions now say to buy the goods elsewhere and bring them back, and suggest where.
🕹️ Arcade: keys typed into text boxes are no longer treated as game keys.

kids: 🎓 Starlane: 12 training tours — watch Nova fly while the keys and mouse light up
💾 Save your game under different names and go back to any of them
🛬 Matching the station’s spin now really works (it was turning the wrong way!)
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Save as… / Open… named saves (opening keeps the current game as “Where I was”); 12 training tours in a practice game (station screens, trading, upgrades, missions, flying, hyperspace, jump drive, lasers, missiles/ECM, mining and scooping, stars and planets, docking) with an on-screen keyboard and mouse; fixed the spin-match lock, which turned the ship the wrong way.

kids: 🪑 Starlane: sit in your normal cockpit inside the station — every control where it is in flight, looking out at the shuttle bay
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: a second way to sit in the cockpit at a station — “Cockpit: flight controls” shows the flight cockpit exactly as in flight (console screens, switch wings, mirror and side windows, widescreen in full screen) looking into the hangar. Weapons and flight systems are safe while docked; view, camera, map, missions, hold, tips and menu work; LAUNCH gives the pre-flight warning first. The pre-flight view is still there, and you can swap between them.
